Sepp’s Workshop · Iconography

The theme ships no icons. These are the sets it recommends, per layer.

Recommendations

LayerRecommendationLicenseNote
App UI glyphsLucideISCButtons, menus and toolbars in web and app UI. Strokes use currentColor, so a glyph takes the foreground of its container.
Alternative for rarer glyphsTabler IconsMITFor rarer glyphs. It mixes outline and filled styles, so each icon is a design decision.
File icons: vscodeMaterial Icon ThemeMITCovers nearly every file type VS Code recognises. Independent of the colour theme; the user installs it separately.
File icons: neovimnvim-web-deviconsMITDraws Nerd Font glyphs, so it needs the Nerd Font from typography.mono.nerd_font.
File icons: helixNerd FontOFL-1.1Helix shows file icons through the terminal font. Use typography.mono.nerd_font.
File icons: jetbrainsBuilt-inJetBrains IDEs offer no user-configurable file icons. Accept the default.
Desktop (GTK)PapirusGPL-3.0File manager, taskbar and launcher on GTK desktops. papirus-folders tints the folder icons; choose the yellow folder to sit with the accent.

Rule

Do not recolour file icons. They encode the file type. Recolour only folder icons, where the target supports it, and the chrome around them.
